[ASSISTANT_SAID] New Zealand's South Island is described as a hiker's paradise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations to the user for getting hiking practice in at Mount Diablo State Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Routeburn Track is an iconic and popular hike.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested multi-day hikes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Milford Track: 33-mile, 4-day hike through Fiordland National Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Kepler Track: 37-mile, 4-day hike in Fiordland National Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Rees-Dart Track: 43-mile, 4-5 day hike in Mount Aspiring National Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Rakiura Track: 19-mile, 3-day hike on Stewart Island.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested day hikes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Hooker Valley Track: 6-mile, moderately difficult hike in Aoraki Mount Cook National Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Lake Marian Track: 4-mile, moderately difficult hike in Fiordland National Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Ben Lomond Track: 6-mile hike in Queenstown.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Roys Peak Track: 5-mile, moderately difficult hike in Wanaka.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when researching trails:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Distance and difficulty  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Weather  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Accommodation  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Permits  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Transportation
